plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Calix E5-111 Ethernet access / MSAN devices (enterprise PEN 6321, E5-111-IESCOMMON-MIB). It reports uptime, system temperature sensors, fan speed, sensor voltages, and interface traffic.
name: Access

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each system sensor of the Calix E5-111 in degrees Celsius, from E5-111-IESCOMMON-MIB iesSysTempCurValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.6321.1.2.3.2.98.2.3.1.2). The sensor tag carries iesSysTempDescr. Values outside -50 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Rotation speed of each fan in revolutions per minute, from E5-111-IESCOMMON-MIB iesFanRpmCurValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.6321.1.2.3.2.98.2.1.1.2). The fan tag carries iesFanRpmDescr.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Voltage of each sensor in volts, converted from millivolts reported by E5-111-IESCOMMON-MIB iesVoltageCurValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.6321.1.2.3.2.98.2.2.1.2). The sensor tag carries iesVoltageDescr.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
